scope: Verified internal template/native/web operations; not a claim of marketplace quality for every generated artifact.

visualReview.repair: Black picture carriers replaced by transparent native placeholders over neutral text-clue layout shapes; corrected native paint order.

retirement.method: recoverable quarantine outside active package; permanent deletion rejected by automatic approval policy

limitations: Source-preserving edits are tested for selected native objects, not arbitrary lossless PPTX roundtrips.
PowerPoint rendering verified; Keynote, Google Slides, LibreOffice rendering, online image providers, narration/video generation and end-to-end local UI interactions are not verified.
Fixtures prove engineering behavior, not marketplace design readiness.
Python libraries, Node libraries and a browser/PowerPoint renderer are ordinary declared dependencies; a donor checkout is not required.
